title: Atlas · knee 9wk — approval once the bar is met

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Sofia, come in. Your knee has had a long conservative run now — where are we?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Nine weeks of physical therapy and it still catches and locks when I pivot.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Locking after that much therapy is a mechanical sign. Who have you been working with?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: With Dr. Imani, same as before. They said they can forward the session notes to you today.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Please have them do that. Any fevers, weight loss, or history of cancer I should know about?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: No, neither. I feel fine otherwise.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: And you are still with Atlas for insurance?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Yes, Atlas Health Plan through work.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Then with nine documented weeks and mechanical locking, let's get an MRI of the knee ordered.
